mapper.insert: insert into project (tenant_id, project_code, project_name, description, status, created_by_user_id) values (#{tenantId}, #{projectCode}, #{projectName}, #{description}, #{status}, #{createdByUserId})
mapper.select: select project_id,tenant_id,project_code,project_name,description,status,created_by_user_id from project where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and status=#{status} order by project_id desc
select project_id,tenant_id,project_code,project_name,description,status,created_by_user_id from project where project_id=#{projectId} and tenant_id=#{tenantId}
